# One command per line, run in order by .github/workflows/expo-upgrade.yml
# Batch 8: expo-doctor cleanup.
# 1) Align SDK 58 packages with the versions Expo expects (17 patch/minor bumps,
#    incl. react-native-safe-area-context 5.10 -> 5.11).
# 2) Dedupe @expo/fingerprint: react-native-health 1.19 pins the old
#    @expo/config-plugins 7.x, which pulls @expo/fingerprint 0.6. Its config
#    plugin isn't in app.json "plugins", so pointing it at the SDK 58 copy is safe.
npx expo install --fix
npm pkg set "overrides.react-native-health.@expo/config-plugins=~58.0.11"
npm install
npm ls @expo/fingerprint @expo/config-plugins
